lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning everyone, and welcome to this short update about our travel plans.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We will leave on the second of May and return ten days later.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The hotel in Lisbon is booked, and the train tickets are almost ready.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Please send me your passport details before the end of this week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If anything changes, call me on my phone and I will fix the plan right away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you all for listening, and I look forward to seeing you at the airport.
